name: Beniiro Tenjou Ayakashi Kitan: Ranmaru Torimonochou
original_name: 紅色天井艶妖綺譚 藍丸捕物帳
source:
After the events of the maingame, Ranmaru & co are back for more adventures.

This time, in the form of our bumbling protagonist hearing the rumors of children getting kidnapped and Tengu and deciding to volunteer work on investigating the matter…

[from [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2012/09/20/bl-game-review-beniiro-tenjou-ayakashi-kitan-fd-ranmaru-torimonochou-by-love-delivery/]Koorin's review[/url]]
